d: Motor vehicle fatalities account for many of the cases that come into the morgue.
Alice receives two life sentences for her role in the slaying of two men. Then, Sarah claims that she made a false murder confession simply to earn a gang status symbol.
Virginia fatally stabs her 81-year-old employer over a forged check. Then, Angela is convicted of shooting her husband and recruiting her children to help dispose of the body.
Sisters Donna and Jeannie are convicted after planning to kill Donna's husband with a hammer. Next, Evelyn pleads guilty to torturing and drowning a woman due to jealousy.
Shiana, Tammy and Heather each find themselves tangled in toxic love triangles where the odd person out ends up murdered.

st: The Real Life Thelma and Louise
d: Bernadette and her lover make tabloid headlines when they lure men to their hotel rooms to rob them at gunpoint. Instead of filing for divorce, Leilani coerces her children to kill her husband.
A hotel clerk calls 9-1-1 complaining of severe facial trauma, but he has no recollection of what happened.
A victim's body spent days decaying before it was found, and decomposition could complicate the investigation.
